content:
I removed all set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false in from Representation.Induced and Representation.FiniteIndex Representation.Coinduced, with significant performance improvement. #43948 #43949

  • :check: build/module/Mathlib.RepresentationTheory.FiniteIndex//instructions: -10.2G (-23.08%)
  • :check: build/module/Mathlib.RepresentationTheory.Induced//instructions: -28.5G (-39.92%)
#43949 (so we get a separate emoji reaction)

Now I have a new design of FiniteIndex.lean #41808, reporting double speed up

  • :check: build/module/Mathlib.RepresentationTheory.FiniteIndex//instructions: -20.9G (-47.18%) (reduced significance based on *//lines)

I am not sure whether we should directly review the new design. For sure the new design is much better, but it needs more than fixing tech debt.
